```{r setup, include=F}
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)
library(pheatmap)
```

```{r}
tpm <- read_tsv("../data/B2B_AKO_BKO tpm.txt")
```

```{r check basal expression}
basal <- tpm %>% 
  filter(treatment == "NS") %>%
  mutate(condition = if_else(condition == "B2B-WT", "WT", condition)) %>%
  mutate(name = paste0(condition, "_", sample)) %>%
  select(Gene, name, tpm) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "name", values_from = "tpm")

write_xlsx(basal, "../data/_wide data/basal expression (NS, tpms).xlsx")

basal_mat <- basal %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  filter(rowSums(. == 0) < 10) %>%
  as.matrix()

basal_mat <- log2(basal_mat + 0.1)

pheatmap(basal_mat, cluster_cols = F)
  
```
